response.sql:
WITH status_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    CASE WHEN archstat IS NULL THEN 'Missing' ELSE archstat END as archstat,
    COUNT(DISTINCT arcref) as project_count
  FROM scanqc
  GROUP BY CASE WHEN archstat IS NULL THEN 'Missing' ELSE archstat END
),
totals AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(project_count) as total_projects
  FROM status_counts
),
with_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    sc.archstat as status,
    sc.project_count as tally,
    sc.project_count::NUMERIC / t.total_projects as share,
    AVG(sc.project_count::NUMERIC / t.total_projects) OVER () as avg_share
  FROM status_counts sc
  CROSS JOIN totals t
)
SELECT 
  status,
  tally,
  share,
  share - avg_share as above_average
FROM with_shares
WHERE share > avg_share
ORDER BY share DESC

assumptions.assumption: "Tally the projects" means count the distinct projects (unique arcref values) per archstat category, not count QC records; this assumes projects can have multiple QC records.

alternatives.interpretation: "Tally the projects" could mean count the number of QC records (rows) per archstat rather than distinct projects—counting how many QC entries exist in each archival status group.
